home.title: Turn inventory, spreadsheets, and database records into one workspace
home.description: The public home page explains the product at a glance. After signing in, users enter the dashboard to manage inventory data, Google Sheets connections, and sync status.

googleSheets.title: Google Sheets connection
googleSheets.description: Plan synchronization from existing spreadsheets so teams can adopt the system while keeping familiar data workflows.

database.title: Supabase database
database.description: Use Supabase PostgreSQL for inventory items, stock movements, user data, and Supabase Auth for sign-in.

stack.title: Modern frontend stack
stack.description: Built with Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Pinia, Nuxt UI, and i18n for a maintainable admin interface.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The signed-in workspace will summarize inventory, Google Sheets connection status, and recent sync activity.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This page shows basic information for the signed-in account. Name, role, and permissions can be added later.

data.title: Data
data.description: This page is reserved for inventory data, Google Sheets sync status, and table management.

auth.signupSuccess: Account created. Check your inbox to confirm your email, then sign in.
